text: It is completely understandable that you are struggling to move past this. When a relationship ends due to constant fighting over disagreements, it can leave you feeling exhausted and stuck in a cycle of "what ifs." Please know that it is okay to feel this way; grieving a relationship takes time, and your feelings are valid.
